list_models.description: List the model packs in the local MTPLX cache (mtplx models). It reads the cache directory, so it needs no running engine. MTPLX serves one model per process, so the list is what could be loaded, not what is loaded. A pack with a missing runtime contract or required file still lists, and loading it fails and restores the previous model.

loaded_models.description: List the model this MTPLX server serves (it serves exactly one). The name it answers with is not the cache id: a machine serving the Qwen3.5 pack answered "youssofal-qwen3.5-4b-mtplx-optimized-speed" while its cache lists that pack as "Youssofal/Qwen3.5-4B-MTPLX-Optimized-Speed", so no spelling of the served name can be matched to a pack by eye. /health reports the directory the pack was loaded from, and that is what residency joins to the listing. The same listing is where load_model reads a pack's directory from.

load_model.description: Serve a different model pack (params: {"model": "<cache id>"}). MTPLX serves one model per process, so this saves the model into the launch arguments and restarts the engine on it; if the new model does not start, the previous one is restored. The argument written is --model with the directory the pack's own listing keeps it in, which is what MTPLX's own app launches with, and a pack given that way is loaded without the completeness checks a cache id goes through first. --model-id is not written: an MTPLX answers as a name that lives inside the pack however it was launched, so the flag pinned nothing, and a value already sitting there is removed, because it names whichever pack was selected when it was last written.

unload_model.description: Eject the model MTPLX is serving (params: {"model": "<cache id>"}). MTPLX cannot drop its model and keep running, so this stops the engine, which frees all of its memory, and takes the pack out of the launch arguments so the engine waits for a model to be chosen instead of coming back on the last one. Load starts it again.

pull_model.description: Download a model pack into the local MTPLX cache (params: {"model": "<Hugging Face id>"}). Needs no running engine, and the download runs in this process, so it is bounded by the action timeout. Once downloaded it appears in list_models and can be served with load_model.

delete_model.description: Delete a model pack from the local MTPLX cache (params: {"model": "<cache id>"}). Eject it first: MTPLX has no in-use guard, so this deletes a pack the running server still has mapped, and it does not take the deleted pack out of the launch arguments of a stopped engine. Download it again to recover either way.
